questions.question: The graph of $y=f(x)$ is a parabola with $x$-intercepts at $0$ and $4$ and vertex $(2,4)$. A new graph is defined by $g(x)=f(x-2)+3$.

answerParts.label: a) Find $f(2)$.
b) Find $g(4)$.

questions.question: The waiting time $W$ (in minutes) for an express bus is modelled as a continuous uniform random variable on the interval $[4,16]$.

answerParts.label: a) Find $E(W)$.
b) Find $\text{Var}(W)$.

questions.question: Exam scores on a state-wide test are modelled by a normal distribution with mean $58$ and standard deviation $3$. Let $W$ be a randomly selected score.
questions.guidance: Standardise with $Z=\frac{W-58}{3}$. Use symmetry or tables for tail probabilities.

answerParts.label: a) Find the $z$-score for a score of $64$.
b) Find $P(W<55)$, correct to three decimal places.

questions.question: In a random sample of $180$ voters, exactly $72$ say they support a proposed policy. Let $\hat{p}$ be the sample proportion of support.

answerParts.label: a) Find $\hat{p}$.
b) Find the standard error of $\hat{p}$, correct to three decimal places.

questions.question: A market researcher surveys $500$ customers and finds $260$ prefer Product A. Let $\hat{p}$ be the sample proportion preferring Product A. Assume a $95\%$ confidence level with critical value $1.96$.

answerParts.label: a) Find the standard error of $\hat{p}$, correct to three decimal places.
b) Find the margin of error for a $95\%$ confidence interval, correct to three decimal places.

questions.question: A $13\,\text{ft}$ ladder leans against a vertical wall. The bottom of the ladder is pulled away from the wall at $3\,\text{ft/s}$. At the instant when the bottom is $5\,\text{ft}$ from the wall, the top is $12\,\text{ft}$ above the ground.
questions.guidance: Use $x^2+y^2=169$ and implicit differentiation with respect to time.

answerParts.label: a) Find the rate at which the top is sliding down the wall at that instant.
b) Find the rate at which the top is sliding down when the bottom is $9\,\text{ft}$ from the wall, with the pulling speed unchanged.

questions.question: A farmer builds a rectangular pen using $60\,\text{m}$ of fencing for three sides; the fourth side is an existing barn wall. The pen has width $x$ metres along the barn and length $60-2x$ metres perpendicular to the barn, for $0<x<30$.

answerParts.label: a) Find the width $x$ that maximises the area.
b) Hence find the maximum possible area.

questions.question: A curve has equation $y=6x-x^2$ for $0\le x\le 6$. A region is bounded by the curve, the $x$-axis, and the lines $x=0$ and $x=3$.
questions.guidance: The maximum of $6x-x^2$ on $[0,6]$ occurs at $x=3$. Area is $\int_0^3(6x-x^2)\,dx$.

answerParts.label: a) Find the maximum value of $y$ on the interval $[0,6]$.
b) Find the area of the bounded region.

questions.question: Water flows into an empty tank at a rate of $R(t)=60-6t$ litres per minute, where $t$ is the time in minutes after filling begins. The tank contains no water at $t=0$.

answerParts.label: a) Find the maximum volume of water in the tank.
b) After the maximum, the volume decreases. Find the next time when the volume is $225$ litres.

questions.question: A packaging error is modelled by the cubic $P(x)=x^3-12x^2+45x-28$, where $x$ is a coded batch number. The polynomial factors completely over the reals.

answerParts.label: a) Find the smallest real root of $P(x)=0$.
b) Find the largest real root of $P(x)=0$.

questions.question: A startup's active users (in hundreds) after $t$ weeks is modelled by $N(t)=1200\times 0.88^t$.

answerParts.label: a) Find $N(3)$, correct to the nearest whole number.
b) Find the initial rate of change $N'(0)$, correct to the nearest whole number.

questions.question: A Ferris wheel passenger's height above ground (in metres) is $h(t)=12+10\sin\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{15}\right)$, where $t$ is the time in minutes after the ride starts at the lowest point.
questions.guidance: The first maximum after $t=0$ occurs when $\sin(\cdot)=1$.

answerParts.label: a) Find $h(5)$, correct to one decimal place.
b) Find the time of the first maximum height after the ride starts.

questions.question: A chemist solves $\ln(x)+\ln(x+2)=\ln(8)$ for $x>0$ when mixing two solutions.

answerParts.label: a) Find the valid solution for $x$.
b) Hence verify the product $x(x+2)$.

questions.question: A particle moves along a line with displacement $s(t)=t^3-6t^2+9t$ metres, where $t\ge 0$ is in seconds.

answerParts.label: a) Find the velocity at $t=2$ seconds.
b) Find the acceleration at $t=2$ seconds.

questions.question: A rational function is defined by $f(x)=\frac{1}{x-2}+1$ for $x\ne 2$.
questions.guidance: Solve $f(x)=3$ for part (a). Evaluate $f(4)$ for part (b).

answerParts.label: a) Find the value of $x$ such that $f(x)=3$.
b) Find $f(4)$.

questions.question: A quality score $X$ takes values $0,1,2,3$ with probabilities $0.1,0.2,0.4,0.3$ respectively.

answerParts.label: a) Find $E(X)$.
b) Find $\text{Var}(X)$.

questions.question: The lifetime $T$ (in years) of a component is exponential with rate $\lambda=0.25$. Thus $P(T>t)=e^{-0.25t}$ for $t\ge 0$.

answerParts.label: a) Find $E(T)$.
b) Find $P(T>8)$, correct to three decimal places.

questions.question: A machine fills bottles so that the volume $X$ (in mL) is normally distributed with mean $100$ and variance $25$.

answerParts.label: a) Find the $z$-score for a volume of $110$ mL.
b) Find $P(X>110)$, correct to three decimal places.

questions.question: In a clinical trial, $64$ out of $256$ patients respond to a treatment. Let $\hat{p}$ be the sample response rate. Use a $99\%$ critical value of $2.58$.

answerParts.label: a) Find the standard error of $\hat{p}$, correct to three decimal places.
b) Find the margin of error for a $99\%$ confidence interval, correct to two decimal places.

questions.question: A pollster wants the standard error of a sample proportion to be at most $0.02$ when the true proportion is $0.5$. The standard error formula $\sqrt{\frac{p(1-p)}{n}}$ is used.

answerParts.label: a) Find the minimum sample size required.
b) For $n=625$ and $p=0.5$, state the standard error.
